run_ideal_observer: run the ideal observer to find the best action and expected reward from a belief state
run_search: run a depth-first search over actions and outcomes to find the best expected reward
create_belief_state: create a BeliefState to track perceived stones, potions, and world state distribution
create_belief_state_with_rotation: create a BeliefStateWithRotation to track belief including possible stone rotations
update_world_state_distribution: update the WorldStateDistribution given a new action and observed outcome
